items.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Plans Store Closures, Is The Pullback A Valuation Opportunity?
items.summary: Starbucks (SBUX) is back in focus after its board approved further steps under the Back to Starbucks plan, including closing about 1% of North America coffeehouses and recording roughly $300 million in related restructuring charges. Recent price action has been choppy. Starbucks shares are down about 10.2% on a 30 day share price return and 8.5% on a 90 day share price return, even as the year to date share price return is 13.7% and the 1 year total shareholder return sits at 16.0%. items.summary: McDonald’s Corporation (NYSE:MCD) and Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) are two of the world’s most recognizable restaurant brands, but they are at very different points in their stories. items.title: Is Chipotle Worth Its Premium Price Tag Relative to Rivals?
items.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG) trades at 28.7 times its past year's earnings, the second-highest price-to-earnings ratio among six large restaurant chains. A price that high makes sense only if Chipotle grows faster or earns more than the chains priced below it. So does Chipotle deliver enough to be worth more than its rivals.

items.title: How Low Can Dutch Bros Stock Go?
items.summary: Dutch Bros (BROS) stock lost 47% over the past three months, while the S&P 500 gained 5.6% (as of September 25, 2026). The shares still cost 55.2 times the coffee chain's yearly profit, against 22.1 times for the S&P 500. The question now is how much lower Dutch Bros stock could go if the whole market falls too.

items.title: Starbucks closing 250 stores, including one in Middle Tennessee
items.summary: According to a letter from CEO Mike Grams, the stores slated for closure are among Starbucks' underperforming locations and represent about 1% of the company's North American portfolio.

items.title: Brewing Trouble? Starbucks Spills the Beans on 250 Store Closures
items.summary: Starbucks faces a $300 million charge to close about 250 North American stores, cut new-store guidance, and shift capital to retrofits amid falling shares and analyst downgrades.
